title: Parameter Authority & Provenance Specification
description: Enforces that every concrete technical parameter in Technical Resolution has a documented authority source, forbidding arbitrary fabricated numbers.

authority_categories.description: Mandated by Composer V3 engine specs (e.g. 1080x1920 canvas, 30fps, H.264/AAC, 1:1 source trim invariant, 1500ms min photo duration).
Defined in Bali style presets (styles/presets.js: luxury_minimal, modern_bold, safe rectangles, TTF font registry).
Derived from physical ffprobe / analysis of the media asset (width, height, fps, duration, sample rate, file_hash).
Physical font metrics measured directly from TTF binary (TrueTypeFontMetrics) or semantic analysis scores from 4A/4B/4C.
Parameter value proposed for empirical calibration in future testing.
Parameter requiring human design approval (e.g. typography hierarchy in multi-field financial cards).
Parameter contingent on upcoming engine features (e.g. automated route map generation).
Parameter intentionally left open because multiple valid options compete.
